title: astrantia major subsp. biebersteinii
intro: Astrantia major subsp. biebersteinii, commonly known as Masterwort, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. Masterwort's health benefits also include its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce oxidative stress, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmacology.
